name: bearing-anomaly-detector
task: Anomaly detection: does this vibration window look unlike a healthy bearing?
algorithm: Smile IsolationForest, 300 trees, threshold = 99.5th percentile of held-out healthy scores at 0-2 hp

dataset.name: CWRU Bearing Data Center, 12 kHz drive end, 0.007 in, 0-3 hp
dataset.splitStrategy: healthy 0-2 hp: first 70% fit, last 30% calibration; test healthy 3 hp + all faults

features.name: kurtosis
features.definition: Fourth standardised moment (3 for Gaussian noise)

features.name: band_0_1000hz
features.definition: Share of spectral energy between 0 and 1000 Hz

features.name: band_1000_2000hz
features.definition: Share of spectral energy between 1000 and 2000 Hz

features.name: band_2000_3000hz
features.definition: Share of spectral energy between 2000 and 3000 Hz

features.name: band_3000_4000hz
features.definition: Share of spectral energy between 3000 and 4000 Hz

features.name: band_4000_6000hz
features.definition: Share of spectral energy between 4000 and 6000 Hz

limitations: Per-window false alarms are higher on unseen loads; raise an alarm only after 3 consecutive abnormal windows (alarm_* metrics).
Healthy baseline comes from one test rig; recalibrate the threshold on each plant machine.
Expects 1024-sample windows at 12 kHz in g units.
